title: 7 Pickups Americans Are Walking Away From Before 2027 (The Real Reasons)
description:
Seven pickups that were cancelled, cut back, or are in trouble heading into 2027, and what each one tells you before you sign for a truck. Every figure comes from a published source, listed below.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
1:46 1. Nissan Titan
3:58 2. Ram 1500 REV
6:27 3. Ford F-150 Lightning
9:36 4. GMC Hummer EV and Factory Zero
12:06 5. Chevrolet Silverado medium-duty
14:43 6. Hyundai Santa Cruz
17:14 7. Tesla Cybertruck
19:42 What to check before you buy in 2027

Sources:
- CarScoops, 2025 US sales: https://carscoops.com/2026/01/2025-us-car-sales-trucks-win-again-evs-slide
- Motor Authority, Nissan Titan: https://www.motorauthority.com/news/1140417_nissan-titan-dies-after-2024
- InsideEVs, Ram 1500 REV cancelled: https://insideevs.com/news/772186/ram-1500-rev-dead/
- Electrek, F-150 Lightning vs Cybertruck: https://electrek.co/2026/01/13/ford-f150-lightning-outsold-tesla-cybertruck-canceled-not-selling-enough/
- Fox Business, Ford $19.5B charge (Dec 16, 2025): https://www.foxbusiness.com/markets/ford-cuts-electric-f-150-lightning-production-takes-19-5b-charge-strategic-shift
- Pickup Truck Talk, Lightning end and sales: https://pickuptrucktalk.com/2025/12/storm-clears-ford-ends-production-of-f-150-lightning-ev-pickup/
- InsideEVs, GM Factory Zero pause: https://insideevs.com/news/791616/gm-factory-zero-production-pause-evs/
- Motor1, Silverado medium-duty: https://www.motor1.com/news/795989/chevrolet-silverado-medium-duty-trucks-discontinued/
- GM Authority, Silverado MD production over: https://gmauthority.com/blog/2026/09/chevy-silverado-md-production-is-over/
- The Autopian, Hyundai Santa Cruz: https://www.theautopian.com/the-santa-cruz-is-reportedly-dying-but-hyundai-says-making-it-was-a-valuable-learning-experience/
- InsideEVs, Cybertruck 2025 sales: https://insideevs.com/news/784715/tesla-cybertruck-ev-sales-drop-2025/
